name: litellm-cost-throttle
description: Test 3 config window on LiteLLM v1.103.2: throttle instead of block. Needs litellm_settings.budget_exceeded_throttle_percentage: 0.5 in config.yaml and the t3-throttle key (rpm_limit 4, max_budget $0.00001, throttle_on_budget_exceeded; README.md). After the first request the key is over budget; instead of a budget 429 it keeps working at half its rpm (2 a minute), then gets a rate-limit 429.
